Natural Language Query: From what date and to what date do the staff work on a project that has the most staff and has staff in a leader role?
LLM Query:
SELECT the_project.project_id, MIN(date_from) AS start_date, MAX(date_to) AS end_date
FROM (
  SELECT project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT staff_id) AS staff_count
  FROM Project_Staff
  GROUP BY project_id
  ORDER BY staff_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS the_project
JOIN Project_Staff ON the_project.project_id = Project_Staff.project_id
WHERE role_code IN (
  SELECT role_code
  FROM Staff_Roles
  WHERE role_description LIKE '%leader%'
)
GROUP BY the_project.project_id;
Gold Query: WITH Options AS (SELECT project_id FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  'leader'), MaxStaffTeam AS ( SELECT project_id FROM Project_Staff GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT date_from, date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM Options INTERSECT SELECT project_id FROM MaxStaffTeam)
Error Description: Join eliminates all staff on the project that are not the lead

Natural Language Query: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
LLM Query:
SELECT cards.name, rulings.text, cards.hasContentWarning
FROM cards
JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
WHERE cards.artist = 'Stephen Daniel' AND (cards.hasContentWarning = 1 OR cards.isAlternative = 1 OR cards.isPromo = 1 OR cards.isReprint = 1 OR cards.isReserved = 1 OR cards.isStarter = 1 OR cards.isStorySpotlight = 1 OR cards.isTextless = 1 OR cards.isTimeshifted = 1);
Gold Query: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
Error Description: Unnecessary selection of categories

Natural Language Query: What is the latitude, longitude, and city of the station from which the trip with smallest duration started?
LLM Query:
SELECT station.lat, station.long, station.city
FROM station
JOIN trip ON station.id = trip.start_station_id
ORDER BY trip.duration ASC
LIMIT 1;
Gold Query: SELECT T1.lat ,  T1.long ,  T1.city FROM station AS T1 JOIN trip AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.start_station_id ORDER BY T2.duration LIMIT 1

Natural Language Query: What are the id and name of the stations that have ever had more than 12 bikes available?
LLM Query:
SELECT station.id, station.name 
FROM station 
JOIN status 
ON station.id = status.station_id 
WHERE status.bikes_available > 12 
GROUP BY station.id, station.name;
Gold Query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM station AS T1 JOIN status AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.station_id WHERE T2.bikes_available  >  12

Natural Language Query: Find the attribute data type for the attribute named "Green".
Gold Query: SELECT attribute_data_type FROM Attribute_Definitions WHERE attribute_name  =  "Green"

Natural Language Query: Give me ids for all the trip that took place in a zip code area with average mean temperature above 60.
LLM Query:
SELECT trip.id
FROM trip
JOIN weather ON trip.zip_code = weather.zip_code
GROUP BY trip.id
HAVING AVG(weather.mean_temperature_f) > 60;
Gold Query: SELECT T1.id FROM trip AS T1 JOIN weather AS T2 ON T1.zip_code  =  T2.zip_code GROUP BY T2.zip_code HAVING avg(T2.mean_temperature_f)  >  60
Error Description: Groups by trip id, not zip code.

Natural Language Query: What is the phone number of the school that has the highest average score in Math?
LLM Query:
SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;
Gold Query: SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1

Natural Language Query: What are the response received dates for the documents described as 'Regular' or granted with more than 100?
LLM Query:
SELECT Documents.response_received_date
FROM Documents
JOIN Document_Types ON Documents.document_type_code = Document_Types.document_type_code
JOIN Grants ON Documents.grant_id = Grants.grant_id
WHERE Document_Types.document_description = 'Regular' OR Grants.grant_amount > 100;
Gold Query: SELECT T1.response_received_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Document_Types AS T2 ON T1.document_type_code  =  T2.document_type_code JOIN Grants AS T3 ON T1.grant_id  =  T3.grant_id WHERE T2.document_description  =  'Regular' OR T3.grant_amount  >  100
